Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Medication: Allowed: - Procrit. - Amphotericin B (1 mg/kg up to 5 days/week). - Prophylaxis treatment as per ACTG recommendations for Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia. - Acyclovir (up to 1000 mg/day PO; for > 1000 mg/day PO or for any IV dose, suggest interrupting ddC). - Ketoconazole (up to 10 mg/kg/day). - Nystatin. - Aspirin, acetaminophen, sedatives, and barbiturates (for up to 72 hours). - Isoniazid (INH), if there is no evidence of peripheral neuropathy at entry. Children should receive pyridoxine, 25 - 50 mg/day to avoid possible INH-associated neuropathy. - Trimethoprim / sulfamethoxazole (T/S). - Immunoglobulin therapy. - Aerosolized pentamidine. - Drugs with little nephro-, hepato-, cytotoxicity that the patient has been taking and tolerating well for an ongoing condition.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not receiving any of the listed concurrent medications; criteria do not apply to current regimen.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Treatment: Allowed: - Immunoglobulin therapy. - Nutritional support (for children with wasting syndrome and/or malnutritional) including hyperalimentation (TPN) of dietary supplements.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not receiving immunoglobulin therapy or nutritional support; criteria do not apply.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: AMENDED: - Patients enrolled in ACTG 051 may participate in ACTG 138 if they show intolerance to AZT or show disease progression after 6 months of AZT therapy and meet entry criteria for the study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of ACTG 051 enrollment or AZT-related intolerance; criteria do not apply.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have the following: - Absence of acute opportunistic infection at time of entry. - However, if patient is successfully treated for opportunistic infection and has remained stable for 2 weeks after treatment, the patient is then allowed to enter the study. Children receiving maintenance therapy for > 4 weeks are eligible.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No acute opportunistic infection is documented; criterion is satisfied.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Parent or guardian available to give written informed consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: AMENDED: - AZT or ddI up until study entry, other antiretrovirals up until 4 weeks of study entry Allowed: - Zidovudine (AZT) within 4 weeks of entry. - Dideoxyinosine (ddI) within 43 weeks of entry if no peripheral neuropathy has been observed while receiving ddI. - Other toxicities observed while on ddI must resolve to level 2 or better before patient can begin treatment with ddC. - Vitamin, folate, iron supplements.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not receiving AZT, ddI, or other antiretrovirals; criteria do not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Co-existing Condition: AMENDED: - 04-25-91 Additional excluded symptoms and conditions: - Symptomatic cardiomyopathy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has ischemic cardiomyopathy (documented via heart biopsy), which qualifies as symptomatic cardiomyopathy.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Seizures which are not well controlled by ongoing anticonvulsant therapy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of seizures is documented; criterion does not apply.
No active malignancy is documented; criterion is satisfied.
No history of pancreatitis is documented; criterion does not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Grade I or greater peripheral neuropathy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of peripheral neuropathy is documented; criterion does not apply.
Patient is not receiving AZT; criterion is satisfied.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Acute bacterial infections requiring IV or oral antibiotic treatment at time of entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No acute bacterial infection is documented; criterion is satisfied.
No hypersensitivity to ddC is documented; criterion does not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Medication: Excluded: - Other antiviral agents, biological modifiers, and investigational medications. - Drugs with potential to cause peripheral neuropathy, including chloramphenicol, iodoquinol, phenytoin, ethionamide, gold, ribavirin, vincristine, cisplatin, dapsone, disulfiram, glutethimide, hydralazine, metronidazole, nitrofurantoin.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not receiving any excluded medications; criterion is satisfied.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Active opportunistic infection requiring treatment with an excluded concomitant medication.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No active opportunistic infection is documented; criterion is satisfied.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: Excluded: - Antiretroviral agents (other than zidovudine (AZT) or didanosine (ddI)) within 4 weeks of entry. - Immunomodulating agents such as interferons, isoprinosine, or interleukin-2 within 2 weeks of entry. - Any other experimental therapy, drugs that cause prolonged neutropenia, significant nephrotoxicity, or peripheral neuropathy within 1 week of entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not receiving excluded prior medications; criterion is satisfied.

Recap: Patient is excluded due to symptomatic cardiomyopathy (ischemic cardiomyopathy). All other inclusion criteria are met, and no other exclusion criteria are violated.
